name: How long does a bathroom tub removal project take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a bathroom tub removal project take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Removing a standard bathtub typically takes about half a day to a full day for demolition and cleanup. If the project involves converting the space into a custom walk-in tile shower, the overall remodeling timeline usually extends to one or two weeks. The duration depends heavily on the tub material—such as lightweight acrylic versus heavy cast iron—as well as the extent of subfloor repairs or plumbing reconfigurations needed. A hands-on contractor coordinates plumbing sub-trades alongside carpentry and framing adjustments to keep the schedule moving efficiently without unnecessary downtime.
acceptedAnswer.description: A standard bathtub removal usually takes four to eight hours. If converting the area to a walk-in shower or updating tile, the full remodel generally takes one to two weeks.
